@CategoryTheory.ExactPairing.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    [@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{u_1, u_2} C inst] → C → C → Type u_1
'CategoryTheory.ExactPairing' does not depend on any axioms

@CategoryTheory.tensorLeftHomEquiv.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{u_1, u_2} C inst] →
      (X Y Y' Z : C) →
        [@CategoryTheory.ExactPairing.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1 Y Y'] →
          Equiv.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1}
            (@Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
              (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_2} C
                (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst))
              (@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj.{u_1, u_2} C inst
                (@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.toMonoidalCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) Y' X)
              Z)
            (@Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
              (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_2} C
                (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst))
              X
              (@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj.{u_1, u_2} C inst
                (@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.toMonoidalCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) Y Z))

                (@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.toMonoidalCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) X Y)
              Z)
            (@Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
